REPORT DATE: 07-12-2025 REPORT TIME: 2142 UTC REGION: ATLANTIC SUB REGION: MID ATLANTIC U.S. AREA/BLOCK: NORTH ATLANTIC 7004 IMAGE DATE: 07-12-2025 IMAGE TIME: 1535 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL2B MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 10 METER LOCATION: 40°06"02" N/69°55"03" W AREA: 0.20 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE LINEAR ANOMALY APPEARED TO BE EMANATING FROM THE LOCATION OF WRECK 1487, A KNOWN REPEAT LEAK SOURCE. THE SLICK WAS MOSTLY WHITE AND SHIMMERY IN APPEARANCE, AND WAS DISTINCT FROM NATURAL PHENOMENA. IT MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 2.6 NM IN LENGTH, AND 0.05 NM AT THE WIDEST POINT. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE OUT OF THE NE AT 12 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: SOME CLOUD COVER OBSCURED SEVERAL PORTIONS OF THE ANOMALY, THEREFORE, THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLICK COULD NOT BE CONFIRMED. SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 44.597033, 7.611403 (Approximated from administrative_area_level_2)
Report DescriptionCALLER ADVISED THERE IS UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF MINE TOUCH WATER (UNTREATED) THAT IS BEING RELEASED TO THE ENVIRONMENT DUE TO PIPES BURSTING DUE TO THE SNOW/COLD WEATHER. ADVISED THE PIPES ARE SUPPOSED TO HAVE A TRACING CABLE BUT THE COMPANY IS NOT MAINTAINING THEM. THE MATERIAL DOES ENTER INTO A STREAM. CALLER ADVISED THE COMPANY DRILLED SOME BORE HOLES TO THE OLD WORKING MINE (FROM 1980S) AND IS PUMPING MINE WATER TO THE OLD WORKING. THE DESIGN/WORK WAS DONE BUT IT IS NOT SURVEYED AND THE DESIGN IS DIFFERENT RESULTING IN MATERIAL POSSIBLY ENTERING INTO THE ENVIRONMENT. FORMAL COMPLAINTS WERE PREVIOUSLY MADE AND AGENTS FROM GOVERNMENT OF CANADA WERE ON SITE BUT NOT CONSTRUCTION WAS NEVER DONE. CALLER ALSO MENTIONED IN THE WATER TREATMENT PLANT THERE IS A BIOLOGICAL MEDIUM TO CHEMICALLY SEPARATE SOME OF THE MATERIAL BUT BECAUSE OF THE TEMPERATURE THOSE BIOLOGICAL COMPONENTS ARE NOT WORKING PROPERLY. CALLER ALSO MENTION THE COMPANY IS POSSIBLY PLANNING ON CHANGING THE COMPANY NAME.
